messages.subject: Helio — data processing schedule and sub-processors
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Ahead of sign-off, our data team needs to confirm the sub-processor list and that all processing stays in the UK. Can you confirm the three sub-processors named in Schedule 5 and that there are no international transfers without our consent? We also want the 48-hour breach-notification commitment to remain.

Robert Aldous
Head of Data & Analytics, Pennine Mutual

messages.subject: RE: Helio — data processing schedule and sub-processors
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert,

Confirmed. The approved sub-processors are Helio Cloud Infrastructure (UK), Aldgate Managed Backup and Sentry Mail Notifications — all UK-based. There are no transfers outside the UK without your prior written consent (clause 10.3), and the 48-hour breach-notification commitment stays in clause 10.4 and the DPA. The standalone DPA reflects all of this.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
